package.name: pupil_ros2_driver
package.description:
ROS 2 driver for the Pupil Core open-source eye-tracking platform.
Provides three nodes: camera_node — streams the world camera and both eye cameras as sensor_msgs/Image topics by connecting to Pupil Capture / Service over the ZeroMQ Network API. gaze_node — publishes raw pupil detections and mapped gaze data received from Pupil Capture / Service. eye_tracking_node — subscribes to the raw eye-camera Image topics and runs a standalone online pupil-detection and gaze- estimation pipeline entirely within ROS 2.
